verdict.rationale: Docs claim Bugbot finds bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code-quality issues on every PR (cursor-bugbot-docs-13, -24), and one HN commenter corroborates that it 'finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss' and is 'shockingly effective' (cursor-bugbot-comm-2, -4). However, other hands-on reports concretely contradict this: one engineer describes Bugbot recommending fixes then arguing to revert them, leading the team to disable auto-review (cursor-bugbot-comm-1), and another calls its review comments 'subtly wrong' (cursor-bugbot-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on bug-catching precision/recall, more consistent community consensus, and evidence distinguishing logic/race-condition catches from style nits.
